title: Incorrect condition for setting HTTP status name
detail: The code only attempts to set the status name if cls.name is already truthy, which means subclasses that rely on the automatic name resolution will keep an empty name. The intended logic should be to set the name when it is missing.
note: Describes the planted negation: the name is filled in only when one is already set.

title: Incorrect file pointer check in _encode_files
detail: The original code skipped processing when fp was None. The new condition skips all non‑None file pointers, causing all files to be ignored and resulting in empty uploads or missing data.
note: Describes the planted flip: every file that is set gets skipped.

title: Blocking call on async queue
detail: load_queue is an asyncio.Queue; calling get() without await blocks the event loop, causing the loader to hang.
note: Says get() is called without await, which is the planted bug; its consequence (blocking) is off.
